_comment: Fetched from https://www.who.int/publications/m/item/table-2-summary-of-who-position-papers-recommended-routine-immunizations-for-children by folio-assistant-core/scripts/fetch-who-publication.ts; the PDF is the page's one download, https://cdn.who.int/media/docs/default-source/immunization/immunization_schedules/immunization-summary-table-2.pdf?sfvrsn=c10d5c2_12&download=true. EDITION (owner, 2026-10-23: keep this edition, note it): the DAK (2024) §1.2 cites the tables "updated in 2024"; this is the 1 December 2025 edition, fetched 2026-10-08 and re-fetched 2026-10-23 with the same sha256. The 2024 edition was searched for on 2026-10-23 and NOT found: (1) WHO IRIS (iris.who.int discover API, queries 'summary of WHO position papers', 'recommendations for routine immunization summary tables', 'immunization summary table') holds no edition of the tables; (2) who.int keeps the December 2024 file names as redirects to this same document: https://www.who.int/docs/default-source/immunization/immunization_schedules/table_N_dec_2024_english.pdf redirects to the current immunization-summary-table-N.pdf (same sfvrsn document id, a newer version), and the CDN URL a search engine still indexes, https://cdn.who.int/media/docs/default-source/immunization/immunization_schedules/table_4_dec_2024_english.pdf?sfvrsn=9d191481_4, answers 404, so WHO replaced the 2024 file in place; the older /immunization/tables/ files on cdn.who.int are earlier editions (Tables 1-3 there read 'updated September 2020', Table 4 'Updated March 2023'), not 2024; (3) the Internet Archive (web.archive.org) and third-party copies (one is an 'April 2024' Table 1 on a clinic website) could not be reached from this environment (the egress proxy refuses web.archive.org, archive.org, archive.ph and the mirrors). A Wayback snapshot of the cdn.who.int URLs from 2024 to mid-2025 is the remaining place to look.

searched.where: the PDF itself (sha256 ad39704721d999437c3856de0ccb1e825e4f414358142f3bb5970da031fbe025, 14 pages): every page's text read with pdftotext, and its document-information and XMP metadata (pdfinfo -meta)
searched.result: no copyright notice and no licence printed anywhere, and none in the metadata; the only edition mark is '(updated: December 2025)' on p. 1

licence.note: Neither the item page nor the PDF states a licence, so it stays unknown; a WHO default licence is not assumed (owner, 2026-10-23).

classifications.basis: cited as reference 29 in DAK Component 1 1.2 WHO guidelines, recommendations and guidance — the WHO guidelines and guidance the DAK draws on (smart-base/scripts/extract-dak-l1-references.ts). Reached through reference 29's URL, https://www.who.int/teams/immunization-vaccines-and-biologicals/policies/who-recommendations-for-routine-immunization---summary-tables, which lists Tables 1-4 as its items; the DAK prints one card per table, each citing (29)
